modules.name: Anthropic Compliance API
modules.summary: Poll the Anthropic Compliance API for organization activity, and optionally for chat and session content.

modules.name: Automox
modules.summary: Poll Automox for operational events and OCSF-formatted audit trail activity.

modules.name: Bitdefender GravityZone
modules.summary: Poll the Bitdefender GravityZone API for security incidents, quarantine items, endpoints, and blocklist entries.

modules.name: Cato Networks
modules.summary: Poll the Cato Networks GraphQL events feed for security and network events.

modules.name: Cynet 360
modules.summary: Poll the Cynet 360 Alerts API for security alerts and status changes. Supports both SaaS (V3) and On-Prem (V1) deployments.

modules.name: Datadog
modules.summary: Post batches to the Datadog Logs API.

modules.name: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch
modules.summary: Post batches to an Elasticsearch or OpenSearch cluster via the Bulk API.

modules.name: Huntress
modules.summary: Poll the Huntress REST API for incident reports, escalations, and detection signals.

modules.name: Grafana Loki
modules.summary: Post batches to a Grafana Loki instance via the push API.

modules.name: NinjaRMM
modules.summary: Poll NinjaRMM alerts and activities for the organisations you select.

modules.name: Okta
modules.summary: Poll the Okta System Log for security, authentication, and lifecycle events.

modules.name: OpenAI
modules.summary: Poll OpenAI Admin Audit Logs and/or Compliance Logs Platform for security and compliance events.

modules.name: Rapid7 InsightIDR
modules.summary: Poll the Rapid7 InsightIDR API for investigations and alerts.

modules.name: Rapid7
modules.summary: Post logs to Rapid7 InsightIDR/InsightOps log search via the webhook endpoint.

modules.name: Rapid7 InsightVM
modules.summary: Poll Rapid7 InsightVM for vulnerabilities, assets, and activity events.

modules.name: Amazon S3
modules.summary: Collect log files from an S3 bucket. Supports CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, ALB access logs, and any vendor that writes CSV, JSON, Syslog, CEF, or raw text to S3.

modules.name: Amazon S3
modules.summary: Write batches to an S3 bucket as time-partitioned objects.

modules.name: Microsoft Sentinel
modules.summary: Post batches to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API (DCR).

modules.name: Forward to syslog server
modules.summary: Relay lines to another syslog collector over UDP, TCP, or TCP with TLS.

modules.name: Tailscale
modules.summary: Poll the Tailscale API for configuration audit logs and network flow logs.

modules.name: Tenable One
modules.summary: Poll Tenable One for activity logs, vulnerability exports, and asset exports.

modules.name: Twingate
modules.summary: Collect Twingate security logs via GraphQL snapshot polling or S3 audit log ingestion.
